prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / card-back redesign.
Generate ONE NEW finished portrait playing-card back, 1024x1536, based on the user's requested corrections. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL Machi Koro card-back reference and is the primary authority for playful composition and schematic illustration style. Image 2 is our previous custom version: keep its restrained dusty sage-blue and cream palette and recognizable building motifs, but IMPROVE its variety, eliminate every repeated building, and replace its stiff alternating rows and monotonous zigzag with the more lively interwoven town composition of image 1. Images 3, 4, 5 supply new landmark silhouettes ONLY; simplify them into the same flat graphic style as image 1, never copy their realistic rendering.
Required EXACTLY EIGHT UNIQUE building groups, each appears ONCE, NO duplicates:
1. One five-storey Soviet PANEL APARTMENT HOUSE with exactly two little white tire-swans in its garden. Preserve the appealing house/swans motif of image 2. Add modest facade variety: a mix of enclosed and open sage balconies, one cream enclosed balcony, a few curtains, one tiny satellite dish, one flowerbox and clear panel seams. Keep it flat and graphic with a readable silhouette, no intricate realism.
2. One small SHAWARMA building with faded terracotta awning. The meat spit must be much SMALLER than in image 2, just a tiny vertical cooking spit visible through a lower service window, occupying at most 8 percent of facade width, not a giant hanging sign.
3. One GARAGE COOPERATIVE: a single linked group of three garages with slightly varied roof heights, brick corner details, red/rust and sage metal doors, hinges, one open door with a tiny simplified workbench and spare tire, and one little gray Volga sedan parked outside. More character and specific features than the anonymous rectangles of image 2, but still clear economical flat shapes. This group counts as ONE object and must not recur elsewhere.
4. One OIL REFINERY: a compact but more articulated network of four slender towers of varied height, two tanks, pipe bends, tiny yellow railing bands and a striped chimney. One industrial group only. A little more detail than image 2, still a flat stylized icon, no black contours or realistic materials.
5. One KARAOKE CLUB, retain the successful dusty burgundy facade with two levels, small windows, curved terracotta canopy and a tiny cream microphone pictogram from image 2.
6. One RAILWAY STATION inspired by image 3: low cream station with central gable, arched windows, simple blue door and round station clock; a small red-and-gray electric commuter train runs alongside on a short separate thin railway line. No railway brand text. Make this a wider horizontal silhouette.
7. One TELEVISION CENTER inspired by image 4: a slender tall Ostankino-like tower with distinctive broad circular observation pod and striped antenna, attached to a low rectangular broadcast building with muted colored facade strips and one small satellite dish. This tall slender landmark creates a vertical counterpoint, around 30 percent of card height, without dominating the card.
8. One SHOPPING CENTER inspired by image 5: low cream commercial facade with a pale slate-teal GLASS PYRAMID roof, simple geometric pane lines, small mauve entrance canopy. This is a distinct triangular silhouette.
Composition: an art-directed whimsical miniature town spread over the tall card, asymmetric and rhythmically balanced like original image 1. Vary size, height, spacing and alignment; stagger objects at different levels with small groups of 2-3, not an even grid, not four horizontal rows, not left/right alternation. A thin ivory schematic road winds between and connects the groups, with 2-3 short side branches, one small loop around a few simple trees, and varied bends and diagonals. It must visibly connect the town and feel purposefully drawn. Keep roads off building facades. Short railway section by the station provides a second linear motif. Add a few tiny varied car silhouettes, one bus-stop sign, a bench near swans, sparse stylized oval/circle/triangle trees, small lawn tufts. These tiny linking details should make the world richer while preserving generous quiet background.
Style: charming schematic geometric screenprint/paper-cut illustration, mostly frontal views with only a little flattened side-plane detail where useful, limited dusty flat colors, clean readable silhouettes. A little more internal detail than image 2, but far less than images 3-5. Absolutely no realistic streets, curb paving, heavy outlines, 3D volume, lighting glow, cast shadows, weathered textures or perspective scene. Faint paper grain only. Restrained low-to-medium contrast, desaturated sage, cream, blue-gray, olive, faded rust and muted mauve. Quiet card back, no vivid accents. Around 45-50 percent calm negative space with objects distributed across the whole card; do not leave a huge empty top strip.
Finish: narrow even warm ivory border, gently rounded inner corners, flat rectangular image, no mockup or perspective card. No title, words, numbers, brand names, logos, card icons, watermark, fake writing. No duplicate panel blocks, garage groups, refinery groups or any other building. Exactly one of each of the eight distinct types. Reinterpret all eight in ONE consistent flat graphic visual language.
